Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Short answer: yes, we can compress the pilot into a single focused day. We do this often for regulated workloads, but it requires a little pre-demo prep so the sessions don't run long.

Proposed plan (half-day compress):
- 09:00–09:30 PST: Intro + business goals (PMs + exec sponsor)
- 09:30–10:30 PST: Security & compliance Q&A (Security + Legal)
- 10:30–11:30 PST: Architecture & network/runbook review (Platform + Ops)
- 11:30–12:30 PST: Live demo & pilot next steps (Engineering + Clinical)

Pre-demo asks from our side: attendee list + roles, SOC 2 scope questions, and an allowlist IP range for our staging cluster (we can provide a temporary host allowlist). I'll loop Aditya (SDR) to run calendar logistics and Dev (Eng) to lead the architecture session.

Attaching a short evidence checklist and a one-click poll for preferred slots. If you confirm the week of May 17–21, we can provision a dedicated sandbox for you and share KMS/crypto notes in advance.
